alignmentImpact.findings: Out of 28 positive validation photos, 22 are non-frontal or extreme profile poses (yaw up to 3.20 rad) where presentation meshes do not cover lateral facial borders. On real aligned frontal faces, filter retention is robust.

changes: Raised hole/hair exclusion overlap threshold from 0.05 (5%) to 0.25 (25%), preventing small peripheral lesions touching exclusion boundary margins from being dropped, while maintaining strict center rejection (exclusion[cy,cx] or hair[cy,cx]).

Replaced single-region 0.65 envelope dominance requirement with general facial skin support check (skin_support >= 0.50) and plurality regional assignment (max overlap >= 0.15), eliminating dropouts for lesions on inter-regional boundaries (nose/cheek, forehead/nose, chin/jaw).

optionalFutureFineTuningPlan.rationale: Current frozen detector is numerically verified and yields low false alarms on negative controls (0.53 FP/photo). If higher raw small-lesion recall (< 15px) is desired, follow this concrete plan.
optionalFutureFineTuningPlan.dataset: 132 training photos from negative-expanded-detector-data.json (834 lesions, 19 fully reviewed negatives)
optionalFutureFineTuningPlan.tiling: Native 384x384 BGR crops with 35px random jitter around lesion centers
optionalFutureFineTuningPlan.loss: BCE with logits for objectness + CIoU loss for bbox regression, loss-masked for unannotated skin
optionalFutureFineTuningPlan.resourceRequirement: CPU execution, batch_size=2, max_epochs=15, estimated 45 minutes on local CPU, disk space < 100 MB
optionalFutureFineTuningPlan.stoppingCriteria: Validation F1 patience of 4 epochs; stop if negative control false positives exceed 1.0/photo
